actual_behavior: Ordinary eligible server tick: Entity.baseTick first copies/clears powder-snow state; LivingEntity.baseTick then ticks effects; Frosted sets the flag and adds amp when amp>0/canFreeze; later LivingEntity.aiStep travel precedes native freezing (+1). With stable amp a>=0, no intervening fire/reset and canFreeze, F_next=min(140,F+a+1). Otherwise native aiStep decays by2 when not powder-snow eligible. No unconditional stun or fixed HP drain.

At base Entity fire processing, remaining fire can request on_fire every20ticks and clears existing frozen ticks before effect tick. Later Entity.move can extinguish remaining fire using the Frosted powder-snow flag; its ordinary collision path is required (noPhysics/early movement branches differ). LivingEntity.baseTick extinguish check precedes Frosted application, not follows it.

Movement contribution is -0.15*(a+1) ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL with distinct modifier id; native frozen-ground penalty is additionally -0.05*min(F,140)/140 ADD_VALUE when standing over nonair. Native attribute order and clamping apply. These are movement penalties, not AI disabling.

After gauge update and frost attribute refresh, every entity tickCount%40==0 with fully frozen/canFreeze requests ownerless minecraft:freeze amount1. Twilight incoming hook for exact minecraft:freeze replaces newDamage with originalDamage+integer(a/2). Normal nonnegative a therefore yields requested1+floor(a/2), before shield/freezing-extra/helmet/iframes/armor/magic/absorption pipeline. Expiration earlier in this tick removes the bonus while the last set powder-snow flag can still produce native gauge+1.

Raw vanilla freeze tag closure: bypasses_armor, bypasses_shield, bypasses_wolf_armor, is_freezing, no_knockback, panic_causes and panic_environmental_causes. Thus native freeze bypasses ordinary armor/shield/Wolf armor, applies extra-types*5, retains Resistance/protection/absorption/cooldown, and has no native hurt knockback. Player freezeDamage=false rejects damage before incoming callback but does not itself disable the frozen gauge.

For IS_FIRE incoming damage, remove Frosted, decrement the same instance amplifier, re-add if nonnegative; hidden chain and remaining duration are retained when removal succeeds. No final HP-damage gate. Fire Resistance, dead/client/invulnerable and player fireDamage/creative rejection occur before incoming event, so they prevent this hook. Shield/cooldown/armor mitigation occurs after it, so an admitted incoming event can downrank even when subsequent damage is rejected.

Fresh effect amplifier clamps0..255. Normal addEffect uses loader applicability and Added events; stronger may hide old weaker state, equal amp extends longer duration, weaker longer duration can be hidden. There is no additive amp stacking. Every tick applies before duration decrement; hidden durations also decrement and may be restored. Removal/expiration are event-vetoable; server attribute removal/refresh follows successful native lifecycle.

Default NeoForge cures for fresh Frosted are milk and protected_by_totem; honey is only added for Poison and does not cure Frosted. Removal does not directly zero frozenTicks; ordinary decay follows unless some other flag/gauge producer remains. Fire remove/readd ignores removal return: an external removal veto can leave the same live instance mutated and normal attribute refresh need not occur; this is retained native hook behavior, not a proposed fix.

Helper excludes freeze-immune entity types, any freeze-immune wearable in HEAD/CHEST/LEGS/FEET, and creative Players. Native LivingEntity.canFreeze additionally excludes spectators and BODY freeze-immune wearables. Those extra exclusions block buildup/periodic freeze, not necessarily the status movement modifier. Environment enforcement uses direct addEffect and deliberately does not repeat helper equipment checks.

actual_behavior: Native boss spawner attempts6 Knights in60-degree radius4 ring; generic range9 plus nearestPlayerY>spawnerY-2 and nonPeaceful. Finalize, assign same GlobalPos home, setNumber(i), add entity; spawned increments only on add success, spawner remains until6 successes. spawned is not custom NBT-saved; partial failure/reload is not a transactional unique six-member group. Hard gives OFFHAND knightmetal_shield only to i=5, before initialization/numbering. getNearbyKnights is class query in own BB.inflate64 with LivingEntity.isAlive and includes self; no group UUID, team, owner, shared home requirement, or six-member cap. Multiple encounters within range can mix; membership is local and geometry-dependent. Each has independent HP35, formation/counter/charge position. Lowest current number in observed list leads normal formation selection; ties can each qualify, no unique shared lock. updateMyNumber copies another number0 home, fills smaller/duplicate indices, tracks maximum known count for bossbar only. Death postmortem renumbers survivors only when BaseTFBoss.shouldSpawnLoot (doMobLoot) permits postmortem; later switchToFormation also renumbers. Group bossbar aggregate/totalKnownKnights is presentation, not a shared HP resource, reserve, heal or damage redistribution.

Initial HOVER90. Formation durations in GOAL update counts: LARGE clockwise/anticlockwise180, SMALL90, four axis traversals180, WAITING10, ATTACK_PLAYER_START50, ATTACK_PLAYER_ATTACK50. Default requiresUpdateEveryTick=false so native selector normally ticks these on alternating game ticks; all-time counters are not seconds. Update goal always active, no flags: sets noPhysics from OLD progress%20!=0, increments, transitions if>=duration, then sends wanted destination speed2 if FLAG_CHARGING else1. Lowest-number leader when ordinary formation ends randomly chooses smallCW2/8,smallCCW2/8, each axis1/8, broadcasts to all observed noncharging Knights including self, then if none charging chooses RANDOM nearby Knight for ATTACK_PLAYER_START. It is not rotating turn order. Large-circle enum destinations are implemented but not selected by this native random chooser; no fabricated large-circle producer is claimed. START -> ATTACK; ATTACK with>1 live near ->WAITING; WAITING after10 copies nearbyKnights[1] formation/progress (query order, not a proven leader lookup), else START. Broadcast does not reset an already charging member. Local lists/goal order, simultaneous transitions and reload mean no globally guaranteed exclusive attacker.

With nearby list size1 at ATTACK end, code first randomly creates sword/axe/pick, THEN switchToFormation(ATTACK_PLAYER_START) calls updateMyNumber. Since there are no OTHER living Knights, nums.isEmpty => setNumber(0), which immediately replaces chosen weapon with sword. Final native survivor therefore reenters sword role; do NOT claim lasting random weapon cycling. A freshly solitary Knight also leaves totalKnownKnights=Integer.MIN_VALUE in that empty-neighbor branch, causing customServerAiStep to retry updateMyNumber each time and reset sword; this field is not an ammunition/shared-health resource. Losses can change surviving weapon roles through renumbering. No regeneration or HP transfer after deaths.

Knight overrides knockback: ignores supplied strength and native KR/hook method, sets impulse, halves current XYZ motion, adds fixed horizontal -ratio/sqrt(xRatio^2+zRatio^2)*.2 and Y+.2, caps Y at.4. There is NO zero-direction guard, so (0,0) produces undefined/NaN horizontal arithmetic; no runtime consequence fabricated. Ordinary native collision push still depends on noPhysics separately. At HP0 native dead damage rejection remains. Base death tick increments; Knight removal requires deathTime>=88 AND no nearby living Knights. At>=18 size set0; corpse can wait while others live, not share their HP. hasYetToDisappear controls initial rise .015 and rendering; last permitted postmortem resets nearby dead Knights deathTime1 and syncs packet, then IT_IS_OVER=true. No resurrection. MobLoot=false skips that reset/renumber postmortem; eventual88/no-live removal still governs. Peaceful spawner/discard and ordinary BaseTFBoss restrictions remain. actual_behavior: Hydra is BaseTFBoss, base HP360/movement0.28, registered root dimensions16x12 and fireproof. Installed multiplayerFightAdjuster=NONE remains pinned. Seven containers each hold one 4x4 HydraHead and five 2x2 HydraNecks; body6x6, two legs2x3 and tail6x2 give46 Entity parts. They are TFPart/NeoForge PartEntity, NOT LivingEntity, with no independent HP. First three containers start IDLE, remaining four DEAD. Root is not pickable; actual parts are pickable and forward the same DamageSource to the parent. NeoForge part IDs/world queries/native Player reach and impact hooks are reused. HydraPart.hurt does not itself reject inactive dimensions or markedDead: parent state admission is decisive. Only head hits add that head counter; neck/body/leg/tail hits affect parent HP without adding a head counter. Multiple queried parts or piercing-arrow part IDs can cause multiple attempts, but all forward to ONE parent cooldown/HP pipeline. A rejected arrow hit can still increase a head counter; nonpiercing arrow callback/discard follows the returned bool, not the counter. No seven independent HP pools or guaranteed multiplied HP damage. Positioning caveat from complete Hydra methods: aiStep explicitly ticks body and both legs (not tail), repositions body and tail (not legs), and container tick repositions head/necks. No dedicated leg reposition call exists; do not assume all46 parts form correctly placed independent body hitboxes. No runtime positioning result or fix is claimed.

Exact part admission order: server IN_WALL first attempts terrain clearing; then reject causing OR direct entity equal to Hydra; reject either equal to any own part; identify the exact head or reject a neck belonging to DYING/DEAD head; compute parent-to-causing-entity distanceSquared (-1 if absent); reject >400, or >600 when DIRECT entity is HydraMortar; reject DYING/DEAD head; forward to BaseTFBoss.hurt. Head interpolated mouth openness strictly>0.5 forwards original amount; every other part/closed head forwards Math.round(amount/8F). Closed-head/body armor is this fixed pre-pipeline reduction, not armor attribute or a bypassable armor tag. Open-head counter adds (int)original amount; closed-head counter adds rounded amount, AFTER hurt regardless of its bool or actual HP. Admission rejects before forwarding add nothing. Native server/alive/fire-resistance/events/shield/cooldown/armor/Resistance/protection/absorption then decide HP. True alone resets ticksSinceDamaged. Parent hurt called directly accepts only BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY; part forwarding deliberately calls super.hurt and avoids that root gate. Hydra.isInvulnerableTo returns false for exact hydra_mortar, otherwise superclass (fireproof included); this exception does not remove later Living fire-resistance, dead/client/event/cooldown checks and does not bypass the root hurt gate. Own unreflected mortar is rejected by owner identity even with the correct type. Source owner range, not projectile range/home radius, governs distant attacks; ownerless source skips range. BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY does not override the preceding part self/range/state gates.

actual_behavior: Each head has integer damageTaken, initially0; addDamage truncates each float request independently, never reads actual HP loss. Server AI schedules DYING only when !isDead and damageTaken>120 (strictly greater, not >=120), ends current action and sets respawnCounter140. It also picks one random current DEAD head whose counter==-1 and schedules140 if any; there is no eighth head. DYING counts as dead for attacks/hurt and active-count, but isActive means state!=DEAD, so DYING is saved as active. DYING lasts70; respawn countdown only decrements while current DEAD. A newly recruited already-DEAD head therefore starts its140 countdown immediately, while the killed head waits through DYING first. At --counter<=0, schedule BORN, reset damageTaken0, end current action and set counter-1. Then BORN20 -> ROAR_START10 -> ROAR_RAWR50 -> IDLE. No parent heal in head regrowth and no fire/cauterize predicate. All seven can ultimately be active. Bite remains restricted to head indexes0..2 and requires active-count>2; all heads can flame/mortar. Loss can reduce concurrency and suppress bites until regrowth; it is not an HP-threshold phase.

Container server tick: tick head/necks; update difficulty; activate nondead zero-width parts or deactivate DEAD parts; advance respawn, then ++ticksProgress and transition when>=ticksNeeded, then position/facing/execute/sounds. A transition sets progress0, so attack runs on entry. Explicit pending next state wins automatic successor; endCurrentAction sets progress=ticksNeeded for next tick. Initial active IDLE uses60/60 (transitions next tick); enum IDLE duration10 thereafter. Durations: BITE_BEGINNING40 -> BITE_READY80 -> BITING7 -> BITE_ENDING40 -> ATTACK_COOLDOWN80 -> IDLE; FLAME_BEGINNING40 -> FLAMING100 -> FLAME_ENDING30 -> cooldown; MORTAR_BEGINNING40 -> MORTAR_SHOOTING25 -> MORTAR_ENDING30 -> cooldown; DYING70 -> DEAD20 loop; birth sequence as above. Secondary attacks replace automatic cooldown with IDLE and clear their flag. Mouth is clamped interpolation previous-state to current-state, not a binary attack flag: idle/cooldown/dead/born/ending0, flame/mortar beginning0.75 and active1, bite beginning0.25/ready1/biting0.2, roar-start0.25/roar1. Thus vulnerable >0.5 includes portions of windup/end/roar, not all attack ticks; for example BITING starts open and closes during seven ticks. Death marks head at1 and five necks at10/20/30/40/50, then each marked part deactivates at its deathTime20. Size/state/mouth/current+last and names are synced through existing multipart data; not independent health.

ticksSinceDamaged increments in aiStep; custom server AI heal(1) only when counter>1000 and divisible5: first1005, then every5 until forwarded hurt true resets0. Native heal event may alter/cancel; setHealth clamps max; no DamageSource and no head-counter reset from healing. Root bypass damage does not use that reset branch. NBT stores NumHeads BITMASK (not numeric count), HeadNames, native HP/home; only set bits queue IDLE/end action on load, with NO clearing of constructor first-three defaults. Thus dead first-three heads are reactivated on reload even with clear saved bits; DYING saved bits also return idle. Per-head damage, pending action/progress/respawn counter, target, regen counter and secondary flag are unsaved. Death tick1 cancels all respawn and interrupts nondead heads to IDLE/hurtTime200; ticks20..140 schedule indexes0..6 DYING when nondead; exactly200 remove KILLED, without ordinary Base tickDeath. Peaceful discards head entities then Base restores valid loaded home spawner/discards root. Head death particles, roars, name clearing and bossbar are not new damage.

Damage request48, twilightforest:hydra_bite, direct=causing=Hydra, not head; entity-type exclusion argument only affects death text. Physical source retains armor/Resistance/protection/absorption/cooldown; preemptive stop-use normally prevents ordinary shield block for that attempt. actual_behavior: FLAMING runs one server look-target query per tick for100 state ticks, not one hit per rendered flame. Track target coordinates toward entity by normalized step0.04 (Hard0.1); facing max5 degrees yaw. Ray source=(headX,headY+1,headZ), view vector, endpoint30. Block.OUTLINE/Fluid.ANY clip supplies a BlockPos even for MISS; candidate AABB is headBB MOVED by look*(per-axis min(30,abs(head-coordinate-hitBlock-coordinate))) and inflated3, NOT a swept30-long box. Normal armor/shield/Resistance/protection/absorption/shared cooldown and fire immunity/Fire Resistance apply. Fire tag is not projectile or explosion. Later burning is native on_fire, a separate source, not repeated hydra_fire; no terrain ignition here.

actual_behavior: MORTAR_SHOOTING progress0/10/20 creates three HydraMortars per state sequence. Owner=parent Hydra via ThrowableProjectile(owner). Position=head look*3.5 plus headY+1; head velocity is zeroed; shootFromRotation(head,pitch,yaw,-20,0.5,1) supplies upward pitch offset and inaccuracy. If current target nonnull and head COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE LOS fails, set megaBlast true (no target => ordinary). Gravity0.05, native throwable movement/collision/impact hook/deflection; type0.75x0.75 fireproof, pickable radius1.5. onHit override dispatches its own entity/block callback and omits superclass Projectile.onHit redirection of a struck projectile. Entity hit server requires owner nonnull; if target another mortar, requires target.getOwner().is(owner), not different owner (ownerless target dereference has no null guard); reject target.is(owner) or own HydraPart while owner Hydra. Allowed entity hit detonates; disallowed hit has no discard. Ordinary block top hit sets vertical speed0 and onGround=true; other faces detonate then still set onGround. Mega detonates on any block. Ground tick calls immutable velocity.multiply(.9) but discards its result: no extra .9 damping is applied. Server fuse starts80 and postdecrements only onGround, detonating when old<=0 (81 grounded checks). No airborne lifetime fuse.

detonate FIRST calls native Level.explode(source=mortar,radius ordinary0.1 or mega4,fire=canEntityGrief(level,mortar),interaction=MOB); THEN loops entities in mortarBB.inflate(1) without owner exclusion or LOS. Non-fire-immune entities OR any Hydra/HydraPart receive18 twilightforest:hydra_mortar direct=mortar, causing=current owner (nullable); only true ignites5 seconds. Finally discard regardless accepted HP damage. There is no separate on-collision18 hit before explosion:18 is the post-explosion nearby query, and ignores explosion exposure. Native explosion source is minecraft:player_explosion when direct mortar and Living indirect owner both exist (despite the type name, original Hydra owner qualifies), otherwise minecraft:explosion. Standard radius/exposure damage formula and separate knockback apply. The18 request is fire-tagged, NOT IS_EXPLOSION or IS_PROJECTILE and NOT armor bypass; Explosion Protection applies to preceding explosion, Fire Protection to the custom18, ordinary Protection/Resistance/absorption/cooldown remain. Explosion may consume cooldown before18, so never sum full damage automatically. Mega block resistance min(original,0.8) except COMMON_PROTECTIONS; native explosion block/event/mobGriefing rules still apply. Ordinary radius0.1 can damage very-near entities; it is not an inert cosmetic explosion. A reflected mortar splash can attempt multiple Hydra parts and counters; closed parts round18/8 to2, open heads forward18, owner-distance<=sqrt600 and shared parent cooldown still apply.

Entity tag REDIRECTABLE_PROJECTILE includes HydraMortar. Native Player.attack after attack-interaction admission invokes AIM_DEFLECT and RETURNS before target.hurt; direction becomes player look normalized (speed1), owner=Player. This normal reflection does NOT clear onGround, extend fuse, use speed1.5 or toggle mega. An incoming projectile using superclass Projectile.onHit can first redirect a tagged mortar to its owner. Separately, a genuine source reaching HydraMortar.hurt calls super.hurt but ignores that return: on server any nonnull causing entity shoots along its look at1.5/inaccuracy0.1, clears onGround, adds20 fuse; only Living causing entity replaces owner; returns true regardless amount. Ownerless/client returns false. Native incoming arrow may therefore run both redirection and hurt callbacks; callers that override onHit may omit the first. Mortar is NOT ITFProjectile; pinned parryNonTwilightAttacks=false means TF timed shield parry does not catch it, despite its Twilight registry name. No custom save methods: inherited projectile saves owner/leftOwner/shot plus Entity position/motion/onGround, but fuse and mega reset80/false on reload. Ordinary Player reflection after reload remains tag-based. Preserve these distinct native paths; do not fabricate a reflected DamageSource.

paths.setup: Phase2 goal only nonclone, acts while uncloaked with target. At attackCooldown%15==0 and server reserve>0/count<3, attempts spawn then decrements reserve even if LOS position/addFreshEntity fails. Native finalized MOB_SUMMONED LichMinion is Zombie subclass with master reference, no default equipment/loot pickup. Hard baby chance nextInt(100)<=20 while babyCount<minion_count/4 (default permits up to3 successful babies), otherwise adult. Missing/dead master seeks nearby nonclone count<3 then native kill if unresolved; master field is not custom-saved. Super-hurt success from ANY causing Lich grants Speed200/amp2 and Strength200/amp1, restores prior target via lastHurtByMob; false gives no buff. Ordinary Zombie melee uses effective ATTACK_DAMAGE, source mob_attack, inherited burning barehand successful-hit ignition; buffs are native effects. Pop goal: nonclone damaged, popCooldown0 and visible tagged Mob nearby; after20..39 held-scepter countdown and uncloaked/server, discard first visible poppable then heal2, cooldown40. Absorb goal: HP<max/2 and own nearby minions>0; after countdown/uncloaked, discard first owned minion then heal its current HP, no LOS test or hurt-success requirement. These discard/heal operations create NO DamageSource and are not player Lifedrain Scepter damage. Normal heal hook/clamp remains. Pop tag includes skeletons,zombie,enderman,spider,creeper,swarm_spider and removes #c:bosses. Inherited Zombie behavior remains: registered Zombie attributes (base HP20, attack3, armor2, speed0.23), baby speed modifier+0.5 total; native finalization randomizes reinforcement chance, knockback/follow range and possible leader HP/door modifiers, so20 is not a universal finalized minion HP. Sun exposure ignites8s unless headwear protects. Barehand burning successful melee can ignite for2*int(effectiveDifficulty) seconds at chance0.3*effectiveDifficulty. Hard, mob-spawning-enabled successful hurt can spawn ordinary Zombie reinforcements after native chance/space/player-distance checks; these are not LichMinion and do not consume/count the Lich reserve. Underwater600ticks then conversion300 (native predecrement completion) can convert to ordinary Drowned through loader conversion hooks, losing LichMinion type/count. Native ZombieGroupData allows baby jockey handling; minion spawn calls addFreshEntity, not an independent guaranteed passenger-add path. No default equipment population does not suppress the separate native calendar/headwear and attribute-finalization branches. These inherited behaviors are pinned to exact244, not treated as new Twilight status types.

paths.native_delivery: SimplifiedAttackGoal canUse requires Living target and native melee-range intersection; checkAndPerformAttack also requires LOS and attackTick<=0. Native unmounted reach is head AABB inflated XZ by sqrt(2.04F)-0.6, not a segment-count radius. Goal flags are empty and requiresUpdateEveryTick=true, so it coexists with movement. The HP hit is ORDINARY_MELEE; only the extra delivery/control is a special package. True hurt can occur with no actual HP loss.

paths.native_delivery: Naga.isInvulnerableTo ordering: nonnull causing entity outside home -> true; nonnull direct entity outside home -> true; IS_EXPLOSION -> true; else super. Home uses floored block positions relative to valid same-dimension restriction point, inclusive |dx|<=46, |dy|<=7, |dz|<=46; invalid/missing home returns true for within-home. No own-position test is added to this damage predicate. Ownerless/directless environment bypasses only the entity-position checks. Thus an inside projectile from an outside owner still fails. These early home/explosion rejections precede super and have no BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY exemption. Registered EntityType fireImmune=true rejects IS_FIRE through native Entity invulnerability; installed fall_damage_immune tag similarly rejects IS_FALL. Normal native invulnerability event can affect that later superclass decision. Naga also overrides isInLava false, not universal immunity to all unnamed damage. No Naga projectile/magic whitelist, flat cap, daze-vulnerability multiplier, shield resource or HP-phase admission threshold exists. Admitted head damage uses exact244 LivingEntity pipeline: invulnerability/client/dead/fire-resistance checks; incoming event; shield/freeze/helmet changes; invulnerableTime>10 rejection or excess; normal armor/toughness, Resistance and protection, absorption, pre/post events/death. No Naga cooldown reset or special short iframe. Naga.hurt only acts after true super return: resets ticksSinceDamaged=0, and if isDazed adds (int)original method argument to damageDuringCurrentStun. This integer accumulator is not actual HP loss; body reduction has already happened, but armor/absorption/cooldown excess have not changed this argument. Server AI forces CIRCLE when accumulator>15 and resets it then only; it is not reset by entering/leaving each daze, so subthreshold totals can carry between dazes. ForceCircle changes state/counter, and daze flag clears when CIRCLE tick executes.

paths.native_delivery: NagaSegment.hurt forwards the SAME DamageSource and amount*2F/3F to parent.hurt when !isInvisible; returns parent result. It neither calls own super.hurt nor subtracts local HP. Multiplication/division occur before parent invulnerability, incoming event, armor, Resistance/protection, absorption and shared hurt cooldown. Native Player attack routes successful item.hurtEnemy to the part parent, but enchantment post-attack still receives the originally hit entity; a legitimate sweeping Living-only query may additionally hit head if geometry/eligibility permits.

paths.source: Native HP loss and subsequent regeneration
paths.native_delivery: Registered base HP120, speed0.5, attack5, follow80, KR0.25, stepheight2. Constructor stores final healthPerSegment=getMaxHealth()/10 =12 for native attributes BEFORE finalizeSpawn. Non-Easy finalization adds difficulty_health_boost +130 Hard else+80 and fills health once: native Easy120/Normal200/Hard250. paths.source: Native head counter crossing and regrowth
paths.native_delivery: Each head has integer damageTaken, initially0; addDamage truncates each float request independently, never reads actual HP loss. Server AI schedules DYING only when !isDead and damageTaken>120 (strictly greater, not >=120), ends current action and sets respawnCounter140. It also picks one random current DEAD head whose counter==-1 and schedules140 if any; there is no eighth head. DYING counts as dead for attacks/hurt and active-count, but isActive means state!=DEAD, so DYING is saved as active. DYING lasts70; respawn countdown only decrements while current DEAD. A newly recruited already-DEAD head therefore starts its140 countdown immediately, while the killed head waits through DYING first. At --counter<=0, schedule BORN, reset damageTaken0, end current action and set counter-1. Then BORN20 -> ROAR_START10 -> ROAR_RAWR50 -> IDLE. No parent heal in head regrowth and no fire/cauterize predicate. All seven can ultimately be active. Bite remains restricted to head indexes0..2 and requires active-count>2; all heads can flame/mortar. Loss can reduce concurrency and suppress bites until regrowth; it is not an HP-threshold phase. Container server tick: tick head/necks; update difficulty; activate nondead zero-width parts or deactivate DEAD parts; advance respawn, then ++ticksProgress and transition when>=ticksNeeded, then position/facing/execute/sounds. A transition sets progress0, so attack runs on entry. Explicit pending next state wins automatic successor; endCurrentAction sets progress=ticksNeeded for next tick. Initial active IDLE uses60/60 (transitions next tick); enum IDLE duration10 thereafter. Durations: BITE_BEGINNING40 -> BITE_READY80 -> BITING7 -> BITE_ENDING40 -> ATTACK_COOLDOWN80 -> IDLE; FLAME_BEGINNING40 -> FLAMING100 -> FLAME_ENDING30 -> cooldown; MORTAR_BEGINNING40 -> MORTAR_SHOOTING25 -> MORTAR_ENDING30 -> cooldown; DYING70 -> DEAD20 loop; birth sequence as above. Secondary attacks replace automatic cooldown with IDLE and clear their flag. Mouth is clamped interpolation previous-state to current-state, not a binary attack flag: idle/cooldown/dead/born/ending0, flame/mortar beginning0.75 and active1, bite beginning0.25/ready1/biting0.2, roar-start0.25/roar1. Thus vulnerable >0.5 includes portions of windup/end/roar, not all attack ticks; for example BITING starts open and closes during seven ticks. Death marks head at1 and five necks at10/20/30/40/50, then each marked part deactivates at its deathTime20. Size/state/mouth/current+last and names are synced through existing multipart data; not independent health.

Closed-head/body armor is this fixed pre-pipeline reduction, not armor attribute or a bypassable armor tag. Open-head counter adds (int)original amount; closed-head counter adds rounded amount, AFTER hurt regardless of its bool or actual HP. Admission rejects before forwarding add nothing. Native server/alive/fire-resistance/events/shield/cooldown/armor/Resistance/protection/absorption then decide HP. True alone resets ticksSinceDamaged.
